CustomField.description: Restricted picklist. Legal values: **Fixed Length**, **Open Ended**. Set explicitly by the launcher / seed generator; the platform does not derive this from the child schedule. Default: `Open Ended`.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Choose *Fixed Length* for pledges, grants, and scheduled gifts with a defined end date. Choose *Open Ended* for recurring gifts with no end date — the donor gives on a regular cadence until they cancel.
